component.name: Zima Connect
component.summary: Securely reach your ZimaOS server over ZeroTier

description.p: Zima Connect is a lightweight companion for your ZimaOS home server. It brings your device into a private ZeroTier network so you can reach it from anywhere, then opens the ZimaOS login page for you.

ul.li: Enter your Remote ID (the ZeroTier network ID shown in ZimaOS under Network → Remote Login)
Runs quietly in the background and reconnects automatically at login
Opens straight to the ZimaOS login once the connection is live
Simple localhost web interface — no accounts, no cloud middleman

screenshot.caption: Enter your Remote ID and connect

description.p: First public release: connect to ZimaOS over ZeroTier, autostart at login, and open the ZimaOS login automatically.
